about: Archive names and cells (ADR-007 rule 4). safeFileName(title) is the name a note, folder or album gets inside the archive; cellText(text) is what a workbook cell holds. Long inputs are written as prefix + repeat * times, and 'length' is the UTF-16 length of the result. sameFile: two paths name one file on a system that ignores case.
